title: Keel project binding (.keel/project.yaml)
description: spec section 8.6 — the ONLY binding versioned in a code repository (invariant 4): which project this repo is, and which workspace resolves its component definitions. The definitions themselves (rules/tools/skills/agents) never live in the repo.

project.description: Project identity, e.g. `project:org/repo` (resolution by repo identity, section 7.1).

workspace.description: Workspace reference that owns the definitions, e.g. `org:local`.

platforms.description: Optional technology platform layers to compose, e.g. [`flutter`, `rust`, `react`].
